summary: Part 5 of the Revibe 11.0 Dashboard (KAMs) video (25:19 to 29:58) covers the Supply dashboard Scores tab and the weekly Thursday score routine (steps 1 to 5, with step 5 for the KAM), the Tools tab (Meeting notes, Seller onboarding, Seller info), a quick look at the Team and Price recs tabs, the KPIs placeholder, and the closing daily routine. All 33 frames in the pack were opened and checked. Subtitles often appear one frame later than the pack's frame ids, so frame ids were corrected where the screen showed a different caption. Step 4 (close buy box below -5%) is narration only; no frame shows its subtitle. Several counts differ between tabs and are logged as unclear. Snapshot footers are dated 2026-10-16, six days before today (2026-10-22).

terms.meaning: The Revibe internal dashboard the KAM works in, with tabs Daily, Periskope, Team, KAM, Sellers, Price recs, KPIs, Scores and Tools.
The tab listing every seller's score, with KPI, score impact and score columns.
The score shown in the Current column of the Scores tab. Implied: this is the score live now, since narration says the new scores become the live ones.
The score calculated this week, shown in the Scores tab. Narration says it becomes live after the weekly update.
A manual change to the score made where a seller's situation justifies it, entered with a rationale.
Tick flagged automatically when New is below -5% (note: auto: new < -5%).
Buybox status column on the Scores tab; the frames show Open. Closed appears in the BUYBOX column on Daily. Step 4 closes the buy box for sellers below -5% (narration).
A collapsed panel that re-ranks buybox quotes using the new scores and Code broken ticks, on the live Buybox quotes.
Collapsible section on the Scores tab, shown next to the checkbox Fulfillment orders count as on time and defect-free.
Narration says it is cleared by keeping seller information up to date in Seller info. The Legal count appears as (17) on Team and (27) on Daily.
A legal document type that Seller info holds for each seller (narration).
Legal document date held in Seller info for each seller (narration).
Three options named for the score adjustment rationale in Seller info; narration defers details to the Scores video.
The monthly GMV that would be at risk if a buybox cost rise passes to price; Price recs ranks rows by it.
The elasticity value shown on Price recs for the GMV at risk and units at risk figures.
The take rate stated on Price recs for the GMV at risk calculation.
Market groupings on Price recs: AE rows cover AE+ZA (shared cost feed); SA is its own feed.
A seller with 30 or more orders (legend: Active sellers (>=30 orders)).
A seller with 1 to 29 orders this month.
Confirmed to shipped within 2 business days, counted on decided orders (Team KPI card).
One of the four KPIs shown on Scores (for example 99%, 400 / 404) and one of the four score point categories named in step 5.
One of the four KPIs shown on Scores (for example 12.9d) and one of the four score point categories named in step 5.
One of the four KPIs shown on Scores (for example 7.5%) and one of the four score point categories named in step 5.
The Tools form used to log every meeting or call with a seller; per the narration the notes feed the meeting sections in Daily, KAM and Sellers.
The name shown per seller in the account manager column and chips on Team and Daily, and as AM name in Price recs action lines (for example Pepe, Yahia, Sherin, Momen, Samaa, Unassigned).

unclear.issue: Two Daily frames near the end disagree. Frame t01785 shows section MEETINGS with Total 100 sellers and no Z And B Mobile row; frame t01797 shows a section heading ORDERS above a card titled Meetings with Total 95 sellers, a Z And B Mobile row, and different last-seen values (SK World 122d vs 123d; Smart Life 95d vs 96d; Renova Devices 88d vs 89d). Which is current is not stated.

Seller counts differ across tabs and the material does not explain them: Team KPI subtitle 78 sellers / 46 active; Daily Meetings Total 100 and 95; Daily All 149 (the account manager chips add to 149); Seller info AVAILABLE SELLERS 223; Legal shows (17) on Team and (27) on Daily. Which number is the KAM's book is not stated.

What Restart, Recover and Correction each mean, and what the rationale field should contain, is not explained in this part (deferred to the Scores video). The score section of Seller info is not visible in any frame.

Step 4 links the -5% threshold (Code broken) to closing the buy box, but the material does not say whether the Code broken flag closes the buy box automatically or whether Pepe does it manually. The step 4 subtitle is not captured in any sampled frame.
How a KPI point becomes score ('Every point ... is score for them next Thursday') is stated only in narration; no frame shows the score mechanics or weights.
The Meeting notes DATE field shows 16/10. It is not stated whether this is today's date or the snapshot date, or whether the KAM should change it. Whether it is pre-filled is also not stated.

The role of Pepe is not stated. Pepe appears as an account manager chip (Pepe 15) on Team and Daily, and as AM Pepe on Price recs actions. The narration assigns Pepe steps 1 to 4, but the material does not say whether Pepe is a KAM or a separate supply role.
Price recs row 4 is cut off in the frame (partial text only: Panawa Tech, 911 to 928, M4U Mobile, 26u last week @901). It is not reliable and is not stated as a fact.

outdated.signal: Narration says KPIs and Periskope are empty for now and will be filled in later; the KPIs tab shows a placeholder titled Vue KPI, à définir.

Price recs header says Live AE+ZA & SA updated 21:59, but the loading frames of the same tab show the footer read-only snapshot 2026-10-16 (six days before today, 2026-10-22). The live figures may be stale.
Tools tab footer reads read-only snapshot 2026-10-16 with KPI logic per revibe-seller-kpis skill; the data is six days old relative to today, 2026-10-22.
Price recs actions use relative time words (this week, this month, 06:00, last week) that are relative to the 2026-10-16 snapshot, not to the day of use.

privacy.what: Seller trading names that read like personal names: Sabir Karim Phones (rows on t01533 and in the t01775 table) and Almas AI Burteqali (price recs row 2 on t01775). They may be businesses, but they should be checked before any screen is shown to sellers.

Price recs action lines show competitor sellers' cost quotes and target prices (for example Gadgethub, MMS Trading, Certifydtek, Dealt, SteppingStone). This is competitive pricing data and should not be shared with other sellers.
Internal account manager names with their seller counts (Pepe 15, Yahia 61, Sherin 30, Momen 23, Samaa 11, Unassigned 9) are staff data and should not be shared with sellers.
Seller trading names with their scores (New, Manual adj., Code broken) are visible. Sellers should only see their own row.
Daily tab lists named sellers with last-seen, status, buybox and KAM columns (for example Luxora Elite, Captain Way, Bilal Sohail Trading). Sellers should only see their own row.
